payload.text: Hugo hasn't said a word. That's how wolves hide.
Louise is far too eager to point fingers.
I spoke with Hugo, he is honest.
Inès dodged every question I asked her.
I am the Seer. Last night I saw Fabrice's card: he is a werewolf.
She is lying. I am the Seer, and Amélie is the wolf.
Bastien has been calm and fair since the start.
Fabrice pushed hardest on Hugo, and Hugo was innocent.
Amélie never spoke before today. Why lie now?
Inès defended Bastien yesterday. Bastien was a wolf.
Julien changed his tune every round. Classic wolf.
Julien, you are playing both sides.
Inès only defended Bastien because he fooled us all.
I have suspected Inès since the first day. It ends now.
Denis voted for Hugo first. Remember that.
Inès is the only one left who defended Bastien.
